name: std::unique_ptr<T,Deleter>::release
intro:
Releases the ownership of the managed object, if any.

get() returns nullptr after the call.

The caller is responsible for cleaning up the object (e.g. by use of get_deleter()).

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: Pointer to the managed object or nullptr if there was no managed object, i.e. the value which would be returned by get() before the call.

summary: Releases the ownership of the managed object, if any.
